uncovered_shapes.sentence: “The bill hasn’t been fully negotiated,” he told reporters, according to The Hill as quoted by Source New Mexico.

claims.claim: Representative Thomas Massie, Republican of Kentucky, set in motion a House impeachment vote on Pete Hegseth that must occur by Wednesday, and House approval would prompt a Senate trial.
claims.episode_span: the House vote must occur by Wednesday
claims.source_title: Thomas Massie Moves to Force Vote on Impeaching Pete Hegseth
claims.supporting_quote: Representative Thomas Massie, Republican of Kentucky, set in motion a vote that must occur by Wednesday. If the House approves the charges, it will prompt a Senate trial.

claims.claim: President Trump said Pete Hegseth won two wars, won the war in Venezuela, called the Maduro raid flawless, said Hegseth is winning the war in Iran, and called Thomas Massie a stone cold loser and sick.
claims.episode_span: he “won two wars,” that he “won the war in Venezuela,”
claims.source_title: Donald Trump doubles down on defense of Pete Hegseth and attacks fresh effort to impeach him – live
claims.supporting_quote: Donald Trump defended defense secretary Pete Hegseth, who is facing articles of impeachment introduced by Republican senator Thomas Massie, saying Hegseth “won two wars”.

claims.claim: Winnipeg is to get a mental health and addictions hospital and 2,000 housing units, with $1 billion in the 2026 federal budget, and Dunn House reported a 52 per cent drop in ER visits and more than $2 million in savings.
claims.episode_span: A mental health and addictions hospital and 2,000 housing units
claims.source_title: What Winnipeg can learn from Toronto’s housing model
claims.supporting_quote: A new mental health and addictions hospital and 2,000 housing units will be built in Winnipeg replicating a housing project based in Toronto that saw a decrease in ER visits and millions of savings.

claims.claim: The US Supreme Court, in an unsigned five-page ruling with only Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson dissenting, allowed border-wall construction to resume in Texas’s Big Bend, including parts of Big Bend National Park.
claims.episode_span: unsigned five-page ruling that suspended a lower-court order
claims.source_title: US supreme court clears way for Trump’s border wall in Texas’s Big Bend
claims.supporting_quote: In an unsigned, five-page ruling , the nation’s highest court granted the Trump administration’s emergency request to suspend a lower court order that had temporarily stopped the project last month.

claims.claim: The Senate voted 73-25 on Monday evening to end debate on the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act, a step that required 60 votes.
claims.source_title: US Senate advances New Mexico US Sen. Heinrich’s controversial permit reform bill
claims.supporting_quote: The U.S. Senate voted 73-25 to end debate on the bill, which requires 60 “yes” votes.

claims.claim: President Trump said he supported the permitting bill but would not approve new wind turbines, calling them a major loser.
claims.episode_span: he would not approve any new wind turbines
claims.source_title: US Senate advances New Mexico US Sen. Heinrich’s controversial permit reform bill
claims.supporting_quote: “The bill hasn’t been fully negotiated,” he told reporters, according to The Hill. “I will not approve wind turbines because wind turbines are a major loser.”

claims.claim: The Carney government spent more than $19 billion on external consultants in its first year despite a promise to cut back.
claims.episode_span: spent more than $19 billion on external consultants
claims.source_title: Carney government spent over $19B on external consultants in its first year
claims.supporting_quote: The federal government spent more than $19 billion on external consultants last year, despite a promise to cut back on its use of outside contractors.

claims.claim: Ottawa doubled the maximum time an employer can hire low-wage temporary foreign workers, kept the six-per-cent unemployment restriction, and added early childhood educators to the exemption list.
claims.episode_span: doubled the maximum time an employer can hire low-wage temporary foreign workers
claims.source_title: Ottawa doubles maximum time employer can hire low-wage temporary foreign workers
claims.supporting_quote: The government said restrictions on hiring temporary foreign workers in cities with unemployment rates above six per cent will remain in place. But Ottawa is adding early childhood educators to the list of professions exempted from those restrictions, which already includes certain jobs in health care, construction and food processing.

claims.claim: Calgary and neighbouring communities recorded five consecutive days below a 500-million-litre daily water target, with Friday at 482 million litres, Saturday at 483 million, and Sunday at 487 million.
claims.episode_span: five straight days in the city’s “green zone,”
claims.source_title: Calgary water use remains in ‘green zone’ as Bearspaw feeder main work progresses
claims.supporting_quote: Calgary and neighbouring communities have now recorded five consecutive days in the “green zone” with water use remaining below the city’s target of 500 million litres a day.

claims.claim: The auditor general reported that the federal government wrote off $4.5 billion in COVID benefit repayments in 2025.
claims.episode_span: wrote off $4.5 billion in COVID benefit repayments in 2025
claims.source_title: Feds wrote off $4.5B in COVID benefit repayments in 2025: auditor general
claims.supporting_quote: Feds wrote off $4.5B in COVID benefit repayments in 2025: auditor general
